verdict.rationale: MX publishes an official OpenAPI specification for its Platform API, covering request and response payloads (mx-docs-26, mx-gh-1), so its account, transaction and identity data comes with documented, machine-readable schemas. The enrichment half of the story rests only on vague marketing about "data-driven intelligence" and "personalized guidance", with no documented enrichment fields an automated workflow could reason over. missing for 10: explicit evidence of JSON response format, documented enrichment fields (e.g. categorization or merchant cleansing), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-consumable output
